issues.legal_issue: A law certified under the constitutional transitional safeguard cannot be challenged on the ground that it contravened the earlier guarantee concerning compensation for compulsory acquisition.
material_facts: The legislation was enacted before the Constitution came into force and received the Governor-General’s assent under the earlier constitutional framework.
After the Constitution came into force, the legislation was submitted for and received presidential certification within the prescribed period.
The landholders challenged provisions governing compensation as colourable and as contravening the earlier guarantee concerning compensation for compulsory acquisition.
The parties did not dispute that the legislation satisfied the requirements for certification.
issues.conclusion: The challenge based on contravention of the earlier compensation guarantee could not be raised in court, and the appeals were dismissed.
issues.legal_principle: Article 31(6) of the Constitution bars a court challenge to a qualifying, certified law on the ground that it contravened Article 31(2) or section 299(2) of the Government of India Act, 1935. The Court distinguished The State of Bihar v. Maharajadhiraja Sir Kameshwar Singh, which concerned legislation enacted under the Constitution and legislative competence under Entry 42 of List III, and referred to Shankari Prasad Singh Deo v. Union of India and Narayan Deo v. State of Orissa.

rule.if: constitutional_challenge and law_enacted_before_new_constitution and law_certified_within_allowed_window and challenge_based_on_earlier_compensation_guarantee

predicates.constitutional_challenge: A person challenges the validity of a state law in constitutional proceedings.
predicates.law_enacted_before_new_constitution: The legislature enacted the law before the new constitutional framework came into force.
predicates.law_certified_within_allowed_window: The law was submitted to and certified by the designated constitutional authority within the permitted period after the new framework came into force.
predicates.challenge_based_on_earlier_compensation_: The challenger alleges that the law contravened the earlier guarantee concerning compensation for compulsory acquisition.

issues.definition: When a constitutional challenge concerns a law enacted before the new constitutional framework, the law was certified within the permitted window, and the challenge relies on the earlier compensation guarantee, the challenge is barred on that ground.
